newsitem.title: USA: Enron closes Portland General merger.
newsitem.headline: Enron closes Portland General merger.

text.p: Enron Corp. said Wednesday it completed its $3 billion merger with Portland General Corp. on Tuesday as scheduled.
The deal called for Enron to issue 50.5 million new common shares to Portland General shareholders, consolidate Portland General's $1.1 billion debt and account for the transaction.
The merger created a company with assets of about $19 billion, it said.
Houston-based Enron is North America's largest wholesale marketer of natural gas and electricity. Portland General is a low-cost electric utility based in Portland, Ore.
Enron stock rose 31 cents to $41.75 in consolidated trading Wednesday on the New York Stock Exchange.
